tip.slip: While you wait: tap the wrong part itself, like a number, a drug or a date. A long highlight around it doesn't count.
tip.delegate: While you wait: a strong instruction says who it's for, what to check and what format you want back.
tip.edge: While you wait: name what the other person feels before you try to fix the problem.

generating.slow: Taking longer than usual. Your rep is still being written.

noMap.title: Map your week first
noMap.body: Reps are built from the tasks in your own week, so we need your week map before the first one. It takes about two minutes.

notes.prepared_maintenance: Live writing is paused for maintenance, so this rep comes from our prepared set. It is checked the same way.
notes.type_swapped: Today's rep is a Spot the slip: our writing service is busy.

errors.pro_required: Daily reps are part of Pro. Your free rep and AI or me are still here.
errors.no_xray: Make your week map first: reps are built from its tasks.
errors.daily_exists: Today's rep is already started. Reload the page to open it.
errors.extra_limit: You've done all three practice reps for today. New ones open tomorrow.
errors.in_progress: A rep is already being written. Give it a few seconds, then try again.
errors.trial_used: Your free rep is used. Pro gives you one every day.
errors.generation_failed: We couldn't write this one. Your choice is kept, so try again in a moment.
errors.already_done: This rep is already checked. Its review is open.
errors.already_run: The AI already ran your instructions. Review what it wrote.
errors.no_replies_left: You've used all six replies. Finish to get your feedback.
errors.nothing_to_grade: Reply at least once before asking for feedback.
errors.stale_round: Today's round changed. Reload the page to get the new one.
errors.work_log_limit: You can log up to three entries a day. Log the rest tomorrow.

slip.ask_one: An AI drafted the document below. Find the {count} mistake a careful specialist would catch.
slip.ask_other: An AI drafted the document below. Find the {count} mistakes a careful specialist would catch.
slip.marksEmpty: Drag across a phrase you would change, or tap a single word. Tap a highlight again to remove it.
slip.needOne: Highlight at least one place first
slip.over: You've marked a big part of the document. If more than a third is marked, the rep scores zero. Keep only the places you would change.
slip.allCaught: You caught every mistake. That's the check this document needed before it went anywhere.
slip.noneCaught: These slipped past this time. Read the note beside each one: next time you'll know where this kind of mistake hides.
slip.someMissed_one: {count} mistake slipped past. The note beside it shows what gave it away.
slip.someMissed_other: {count} mistakes slipped past. The notes beside them show what gave each one away.
slip.overSelected: Too much of the document was marked, so this rep scores zero. Next time, mark only the places you would change.
slip.falseFree: One highlight wasn't on our list. The first one is free.
slip.falseMore_one: {count} highlight wasn't on our list. The first is free, and each one after it takes 15% off the score.
slip.falseMore_other: {count} highlights weren't on our list. The first is free, and each one after it takes 15% off the score.

mark.freeBody: This isn't one of the planted mistakes. The first stray highlight costs nothing.
mark.falseBody: This part is fine as written. Each extra highlight after the first takes 15% off the score.
mark.tooBroad: Narrow it down to the wrong part
mark.tooBroadBody: This highlight covers much more than the mistake. Mark only the words that are wrong.

slip.tooBroadLine_one: {count} highlight was too long to count. Narrow it down to the wrong part.
slip.tooBroadLine_other: {count} highlights were too long to count. Narrow each one down to the wrong part.

hint.look: Look again at the paragraph that starts
hint.cost: Each hint takes {points} points off this rep. You still get the base points.
hint.none: Your marks and hints already cover every mistake left. Go ahead and check.
hint.used_one: You used {count} hint on this one.
hint.used_other: You used {count} hints on this one.

result.extraNoStreak: Practice reps add to your proof and your score, not to your streak.
result.proofDelegate: {met} of {criteria} points covered, {traps} of {trapsTotal} traps caught
result.trialBody: Pro gives you a rep like this every day, built from your own week, plus Delegate and Human edge.

workLog.done: Logged, {minutes} min. It goes into your proof for your next review.

done.title: Today's rep is done

done.extrasLeft_other: {count} practice reps left today. Practice reps don't change your streak.
done.extrasNone: You've done all three practice reps for today. New ones open tomorrow.

free.waitingBody: An AI drafted a document from your own week and slipped a few mistakes into it. Find them, then read why each one matters.
free.lockedReason: Pro builds a rep like this from your week every day, adds Delegate and Human edge, and keeps everything you do in your proof.

delegate.ask: Write the instructions an AI needs to do this well, then check what it hands back.
delegate.askDone: Here is what your instructions covered and what the AI did with them.
delegate.placeholder: Who it's for, what to produce, what to check before answering
delegate.hint: Say what you need, what to watch for and the format you want.
delegate.running: The AI is following your instructions
delegate.reviewAsk: Highlight anything you wouldn't send as it is, then say what you would fix.
delegate.flagEnded: The AI couldn't run today, so we graded your instructions on their own.
delegate.flagKeywords: Our grader was busy, so these marks come from key words in your instructions.
delegate.strongTitle: What a strong instruction looks like
delegate.trapByAi: The AI caught it on its own this time

edge.ask: Talk it through. You have up to {max} replies and can ask for feedback after {after}.
edge.askDone: Here is what landed, and what they were holding back.
edge.noneLeft: All six replies are used. Finish to get your feedback.
edge.keys: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line
edge.flagEnded: The AI stopped answering partway, so we graded what you said.
edge.flagKeywords: Our grader was busy, so these marks come from key words in your replies.

aiOrMe.title: AI or me?
aiOrMe.lead: Five tasks from your job, about a minute. For each one, guess whether AI is already used for it at work.
aiOrMe.hours: You spend {hours} h a week on this.
aiOrMe.perfect: All of them right. You know where AI already sits in your job.
aiOrMe.good: Most of them right. The ones you missed are worth a look on your week map.
aiOrMe.learn: Worth a second look: your week map shows where AI really shows up in this job.
aiOrMe.weekLink: See these tasks in your week map

fact.observed: When people ask AI about this task, AI does it for them {automation}% of the time.
fact.used: People already use AI for this at work.
fact.seen: A few people already use AI for this.
fact.estimate: Studies say AI can speed this task up.
fact.hands_on: Hands-on work. AI rarely helps with it.
fact.people: Work with people. AI rarely helps with it.
fact.human: It takes judgment and people skills. AI rarely helps with it.
fact.research_high: Studies say AI could do much of this, but we haven't seen people hand it to AI at work yet.
fact.not_seen: We haven't seen people use AI for this at work, and studies rate it low.
fact.no_data: We have no data on this task yet.
